verdict.rationale: Supabase is built directly on Postgres (supabase-docs-31), so full SQL joins, constraints, and transactions are available when connecting directly to the database, and RLS policies shown use standard SQL (supabase-docs-15). However, the auto-generated REST/PostgREST API layer that most developers use has documented limitations for complex relational queries, with a hands-on user reporting having to abandon PostgREST for a custom API server due to its limitations (supabase-comm-10), and no evidence pack item explicitly showcases joins or multi-statement transactions via Supabase's client libraries.
